turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise much and many?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can practise this. Shopping and cooking at home use these words every day.

Quick question first: which of these two words do you think goes with things you can count, much or many?

Our goal today: ask and talk about quantities with much and many.

Here is a model sentence about the supermarket (my own example): "How many apples do you need?"

Your task: write two questions about food in your home. Ask one about something you can count and one about something you cannot count. Then we will check them together.
